added_claim.label: ParYR-associated reduced susceptibility to novobiocin
added_claim.note: The comparison concerns laboratory derivatives of the TK24 background, not native-donor susceptibility or species-wide resistance. NCBITaxon:457428 denotes the TK24 background, not the experimental derivative. The reported donor is Streptomyces rishiriensis DSM 40489. UniProtKB:Q83WB8 is reference-only (entry version 120, sequence version 2); the archive succession does not establish the exact experimental allele. The 2003 study leaves ParY enzymatic function unresolved. No induced point mutant, clinical category, numerical AST, derivative TaxID or experimental genome is assigned. Compound scope follows the source's named structure in Figure 1A, not independent re-identification of the tested preparation.
added_claim.phenotype_label: reduced novobiocin susceptibility in a laboratory host

curation_event.changes: Added one qualitative primary-backed ParYR-associated host susceptibility finding; preserved donor/host/reference distinctions and all existing source slices. No exact allele, numerical AST or genome assigned. Whole-record review remains open.
